items.step: step=appliance_static_contract; owner=implementation; success_criteria=add `src/appliance.zig`, `world.Appliance` root re-export, format/fingerprint constants, Manifest/Profile/Capacity/MemoryPlan types, deterministic fingerprint helpers, and focused manifest/memory-plan tests.

step=closed_world_define; owner=implementation; success_criteria=implement `Appliance.Define` compile-time validation and static tables against existing Linker/Fabric/Assembly/Actuation/Supervision inputs; reject unresolved ports, missing bindings, loaded modules, runtime discovery, string dispatch, and hot-path TreatyResolver/ProviderHarness use.

step=actuation_host_membrane; owner=implementation; success_criteria=add `Actuation.Membrane.prepareHost`, `Actuation.Membrane.finalizeHost`, Prepared/Finalized records, and Appliance HostRequest/HostOutcome/HostReply validation with stale, duplicate, wrong request, wrong schema, replay, and no-host-call tests.

step=core_quiescent_turn; owner=implementation; success_criteria=implement Core state machine, canonical Command decode/validate, submit/execute/read/reset/restore operations, deterministic quiescence loop, bounded buffers, capacity failures, inspect/cancel behavior, and no-mutation malformed-input tests.

step=capsule_archive_receipts; owner=implementation; success_criteria=integrate Capsule checkpoint emission/restore, Continuity/Chronicle object evidence, Archive.AppendBatch planning, RetentionAck validation, TurnReceipt creation, and resident/reconstructed reconstruction reports.

step=examples_agent_docs; owner=implementation; success_criteria=build one-port and canonical agent appliances plus examples for one-port, agent, reconstruct, archive, replay, and wasm-probe; update README and `docs/appliance.md` with host responsibility doctrine and non-goals.

step=appliance_abi_wasm; owner=implementation; success_criteria=add Appliance ABI v1 exports, Native ABI-shaped simulation, `world-appliance-wasm`, `check-world-appliance-wasm`, and WASM inspection proving required exports, matching manifest, and zero forbidden imports.

step=conformance_fixed_point; owner=verification; success_criteria=add ConformanceVector/ConformanceReport coverage for native owner APIs, Appliance.Native, resident Core, reconstructed Core, WASM artifact inspection, replay, archive ack/unack, and bounded equivalence trace digest; no duplicate truth owner or unretired scaffold remains.

step=proof_closeout; owner=verification; success_criteria=run requested proof commands: `zig version`; `zig fmt --check build.zig src examples test`; `git diff --check`; `zig build --summary all`; `zig build check --summary all`; existing world/archive wasm checks; new appliance wasm checks; all appliance examples; focused appliance filters; `zig build lint -- --max-warnings 0`; inspect diff and update or open PR only if PR publication is explicitly in scope.

step=appliance_host_protocol_payloads; owner=implementation; success_criteria=canonicalize HostRequest/HostOutcome/HostReply helpers and include deterministic HostRequests in needs-host TurnOutput/Core output with focused validation tests.

step=appliance_command_host_replies; owner=implementation; success_criteria=encode/decode bounded HostReplies in Appliance.Command and have Core validate replies against outstanding HostRequests before completing a continue turn.

step=appliance_command_retention_ack; owner=implementation; success_criteria=carry optional RetentionAck in canonical Appliance.Command bytes and have Core validate acknowledged Archive append fingerprints before accepting the next advancing command.

step=appliance_checkpoint_outstanding_requests; owner=implementation; success_criteria=carry outstanding HostRequest evidence in Appliance.Checkpoint and have Core.restore rehydrate pending host requests so restored continuation can validate the same HostReply as resident Core.

step=appliance_command_restore_checkpoint; owner=implementation; success_criteria=carry an optional Appliance.Checkpoint in canonical restore Command bytes and have Core.submit/executeTurn validate and apply that checkpoint without side-channel restore state.

appliance_turn_receipt_host_evidence; owner=implementation; success_criteria=bind applied HostReply fingerprints and emitted HostRequest fingerprints into Appliance.TurnReceipt and populate them from Core turns so each receipt records the host-visible causal edge.

appliance_turn_receipt_source_evidence; owner=implementation; success_criteria=bind optional prior Checkpoint and source Capsule fingerprints into Appliance.TurnReceipt and populate restore turns from Command checkpoint evidence so receipts record the reconstruction source edge.

appliance_turn_receipt_archive_anchors; owner=implementation; success_criteria=bind resulting Archive Moment, Seal, and Chronicle cursor fingerprints into Appliance.TurnReceipt and populate them from Core retention acknowledgment state so receipts carry archive-result evidence without host storage I/O.

appliance_root_result_evidence; owner=implementation; success_criteria=bind optional root result fingerprints into Appliance.TurnOutput and Appliance.TurnReceipt, have completed Core turns emit a deterministic root-result fingerprint, and reject output/receipt result mismatches.

appliance_wasm_core_execution; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Appliance WASM artifact submits canonical Appliance.Command bytes through Appliance.Core/Native semantics, stores canonical TurnOutput bytes, leaves state/output unchanged on malformed input, and verifier/probe evidence binds the artifact manifest fingerprint.

appliance_native_abi_driver; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Appliance.Native exposes ABI-shaped manifest/output/submit/reset operations over Appliance.Core without bypassing canonical Command/TurnOutput bytes, maps Core errors to stable ABI statuses, and the WASM artifact delegates to Native for command execution.

appliance_command_root_argument_image; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Appliance.Command boot carries a bounded canonical root argument image in encode/decode/fingerprint evidence, rejects root arguments on non-boot commands, and docs/tests cover the boot argument contract.

step=appliance_host_outcome_payloads; owner=implementation; success_criteria=add canonical HostOutcome response_kind, response bytes, and host evidence bytes with bounded validation, encode/decode ownership, fingerprint binding, docs, and focused tests.

step=appliance_host_reply_retention_ack; owner=implementation; success_criteria=carry optional canonical RetentionAck in Appliance.HostReply bytes, derive/validate its fingerprint, free decoded ack metadata, bind it into HostReply fingerprint, update docs/tests, and preserve command-level RetentionAck behavior.

step=appliance_command_receiver_refs; owner=implementation; success_criteria=add optional receiver permit and receiver evidence refs to canonical Appliance.Command bytes, bound and validate nonzero refs, include them in command fingerprint identity, free decoded owned refs, update docs/tests, and preserve existing command behavior when refs are absent.

step=appliance_turn_output_evidence_refs; owner=implementation; success_criteria=add canonical TurnOutput fields for finalized Actuation receipt refs, optional RunReceipt ref, optional Archive.AppendBatch fingerprint, blocker/warning counts, and diagnostic metadata; validate bounds/nonzero refs and receipt parity; bind them into output fingerprint/encoding; update tests/docs; preserve existing behavior when absent.

step=appliance_checkpoint_capsule_image_ref; owner=implementation; success_criteria=add explicit canonical Capsule image bytes or Capsule image ref evidence to Appliance.Checkpoint, require one reconstruction source, bound bytes by Capacity.max_capsule_bytes, validate nonzero refs, bind evidence into checkpoint fingerprint/encoding, free decoded owned bytes, have Core emit a deterministic capsule image ref, update docs/tests/examples, and preserve restore behavior through canonical Checkpoint bytes.

step=appliance_native_manifest_bytes; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Native and WASM ABI-shaped manifest reads expose canonical Appliance.Manifest bytes rather than only a fingerprint, with deterministic length/copy semantics, bounded no-mutation behavior on too-small buffers, and focused tests proving bytes equal Manifest canonical encoding.

step=appliance_wasm_memory_plan_exports; owner=implementation; success_criteria=World Appliance WASM artifact exposes Capacity and MemoryPlan identity/bounds before execution through stable exports, verifier requires those export symbols and reports matching native fingerprints, docs mention the pre-execution memory plan surface, and focused WASM/appliance proof plus aggregate build/check pass.

step=appliance_turn_output_archive_append_ref; owner=implementation; success_criteria=TurnOutput carries an explicit canonical Archive.AppendBatch ref fingerprint alongside the append batch fingerprint, validates nonzero/parity when archive append is present, binds the ref into output fingerprint/encoding, Core emits a deterministic ref for planned archive appends, docs/tests cover the host-visible archive evidence ref, and focused plus aggregate proof pass.

step=appliance_conformance_vector_sequences; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Appliance.ConformanceVector declares the required vector kinds and binds expected TurnOutput, HostReply, status, HostRequest, Checkpoint, final result, Archive.AppendBatch, and resident/reconstructed equivalence evidence into validation/fingerprint identity; ConformanceReport records direct native owner/API, Appliance.Native/Core, resident, reconstructed, WASM inspection, optional runtime, replay, and archive projection comparison evidence; docs/tests cover drift rejection and focused plus aggregate proof pass.

step=appliance_command_host_reply_canonical_order; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Appliance.Command canonicalizes HostReply order by request identity for fingerprinting and encoding, decoded owned replies are normalized before validation/processing, duplicate target replies reject deterministically, tests prove reversed input order yields identical command fingerprints/bytes and duplicate replies fail, and focused plus aggregate proof pass.

step=appliance_pending_deferred_host_outcomes; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Core treats pending/deferred HostOutcome replies as nonterminal Actuation finalization evidence: applied reply is recorded, no finalized Actuation receipt is emitted, parent remains waiting_host with the same outstanding HostRequest in TurnOutput/Checkpoint, duplicate/stale validation remains fail-closed, docs/tests cover pending/deferred parking, and focused plus aggregate proof pass.

step=appliance_archive_unacknowledged_warning; owner=implementation; success_criteria=For profiles that enable Archive append but do not require RetentionAck before continue, Core preserves a deterministic unacknowledged-archive warning in QuiescenceReport, TurnReceipt, and TurnOutput when advancing past a pending Archive.AppendBatch without a matching RetentionAck; strict archive_ack_gate behavior remains fail-closed; docs/tests cover both paths; focused plus aggregate proof pass.

step=appliance_replay_evidence_turns; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Core treats replay/verify/audit commands with receiver evidence as replay evidence that completes without emitting fresh HostRequests, blocks deterministically when replay evidence is missing for an external port, keeps fresh mode behavior unchanged, docs/tests cover the replay-only no-fresh-host-request path, and focused plus aggregate proof pass.

step=appliance_core_state_output_parity; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Core.executeTurn assigns the resulting Core state after successful TurnOutput emission so resident state, ABI status, outstanding HostRequest state, and TurnOutput.status stay observationally aligned across needs_host, completed, blocked, cancelled, and inspected turns; focused plus aggregate proof pass.

step=appliance_native_turn_status_parity; owner=implementation; success_criteria=Appliance.Native submitCommand returns ABI status from the canonical TurnOutput/TurnStatus rather than lossy CoreState alone, preserving distinct needs_host/completed/blocked/cancelled statuses; focused plus aggregate proof pass.
appliance command execution mode manifest gate
appliance reset command leaves Core reusable
appliance native exposes last-error ABI surface
appliance wasm submit treats blocked output as valid
appliance examples use real Core turn outputs
appliance Define validates static assembly-covered ports
appliance submit stages commands without pre-turn state mutation
